Which Analysis Rows Use the Full-Sample Base, and With What Label

Source: R/full_sample.R
ck_full_sample_rows.Rd

The sample_base and na_label columns of the list of analyses decide it row by row (their former names, full_sample_base and full_sample_label, are read too). A blank sample_base cell takes the pipeline argument full_sample_base (FALSE unless a caller set it), and a blank na_label cell takes full_sample_label. Only prop_select_one and prop_select_multiple rows are affected; a mean, median or ratio is left as it is whatever the cell says.

Usage

ck_full_sample_rows(
  loa,
  full_sample_base = FALSE,
  full_sample_label = "Not asked / no response"
)

Arguments

loa

The list of analyses.

full_sample_base

Logical. The value for a row that leaves the cell blank (or every row, when the column is absent).

full_sample_label

The label for a row that leaves the cell blank.

Value

A list with rows (logical, one per loa row) and label (character, one per loa row).
